entities.name: Johannes Teutonicus Zemeke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Teutonicus Zemeke, also Joannes Simeca Teutonicus and John Zimeke, was a Decretist glossator, best known for his glosses on Gratian's Decretum in collaboration with Bartholomew of Brescia.
